account_credential_password_ck.name: account_credential_password_ck
account_credential_password_ck.value: provider_id <> 'credential' OR password IS NOT NULL

profiles_urls_ck.name: profiles_urls_ck
profiles_urls_ck.value:
linkedin_url ~* '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$' AND char_length(linkedin_url) <= 300
        AND github_url ~* '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$' AND char_length(github_url) <= 300
        AND portfolio_url ~* '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$' AND char_length(portfolio_url) <= 300

companies_active_reason_ck.name: companies_active_reason_ck
companies_active_reason_ck.value: (active AND inactive_reason IS NULL) OR (NOT active AND inactive_reason IN ('board_not_found','import_pending','owner'))

companies_hosts_ck.name: companies_hosts_ck
companies_hosts_ck.value:
(ats = 'greenhouse' AND api_region = 'us' AND api_host = 'boards-api.greenhouse.io' AND apply_host IN ('boards.greenhouse.io','job-boards.greenhouse.io'))
        OR (ats = 'lever' AND api_region = 'us' AND api_host = 'api.lever.co' AND apply_host = 'jobs.lever.co')
        OR (ats = 'lever' AND api_region = 'eu' AND api_host = 'api.eu.lever.co' AND apply_host = 'jobs.eu.lever.co')
        OR (ats = 'ashby' AND api_region = 'us' AND api_host = 'api.ashbyhq.com' AND apply_host = 'jobs.ashbyhq.com')

jobs_card_ck.name: jobs_card_ck
jobs_card_ck.value: card IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(card) = 'object' AND octet_length(card::text) <= 16384 AND card_version IS NOT NULL AND card_content_hash IS NOT NULL)

matches_score_ck.name: matches_score_ck
matches_score_ck.value: score IS NULL OR score BETWEEN 0 AND 100

matches_prerank_ck.name: matches_prerank_ck
matches_prerank_ck.value: prerank_score IS NULL OR prerank_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100

matches_must_have_ck.name: matches_must_have_ck
matches_must_have_ck.value: must_have_hits IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(must_have_hits) IN ('array','object') AND octet_length(must_have_hits::text) <= 2048)

applications_approval_shape_ck.name: applications_approval_shape_ck
applications_approval_shape_ck.value:
(status IN ('approved','submitting','submitted','failed') AND approved_at IS NOT NULL AND channel IS NOT NULL)
        OR (status = 'draft' AND approved_at IS NULL AND channel IS NULL) OR status IN ('withdrawn','refunded')

applications_approved_by_ck.name: applications_approved_by_ck
applications_approved_by_ck.value: approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by IN ('user','autopilot')

applications_failure_code_ck.name: applications_failure_code_ck
applications_failure_code_ck.value:
failure_code IS NULL OR failure_code IN ('challenge','posting_closed','required_missing','applier_error','unconfirmed','timeout',
        'no_report','plan_lapsed','cloud_unavailable_for_ats','extension_reported','render_failed')

applications_stage_ck.name: applications_stage_ck
applications_stage_ck.value: stage IS NULL OR stage IN ('applied','in_review','assessment','interviewing','offer','rejected')

applications_lease_ck.name: applications_lease_ck
applications_lease_ck.value:
(lease_session_id IS NULL) = (lease_expires_at IS NULL)
        AND (lease_session_id IS NULL OR (status IN ('approved','submitting') AND channel = 'extension'))

applications_autopilot_ck.name: applications_autopilot_ck
applications_autopilot_ck.value: approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM 'autopilot' OR gate_override = false

applications_expired_ck.name: applications_expired_ck
applications_expired_ck.value:
draft_state <> 'expired' OR (status IN ('draft','withdrawn') AND resume_lines = '[]'::jsonb AND answers = '[]'::jsonb
        AND cover_letter IS NULL AND resume_file_key IS NULL AND resume_snapshot IS NULL)

applications_scrub_ck.name: applications_scrub_ck
applications_scrub_ck.value: content_scrubbed_at IS NULL OR status IN ('submitted','withdrawn')

applications_snapshot_ck.name: applications_snapshot_ck
applications_snapshot_ck.value:
(status <> 'draft' OR (resume_snapshot IS NULL AND resume_file_key IS NULL))
        AND (resume_snapshot IS NULL OR octet_length(resume_snapshot::text) <= 400000)

applications_json_ck.name: applications_json_ck
applications_json_ck.value:
jsonb_typeof(resume_lines) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(resume_lines) <= 200
        AND jsonb_typeof(answers) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(answers) <= 200
        AND (questions IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(questions) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(questions) <= 200))
        AND (verification IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(verification) = 'object'
             AND verification->>'state' IN ('none','pending','passed','failed') AND pg_column_size(verification) <= 16384))
        AND (resume_line_entries IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(resume_line_entries) = 'object' AND pg_column_size(resume_line_entries) <= 16384))
        AND (receipt IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(receipt) = 'object')
        AND (receipt_summary IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(receipt_summary) = 'object')

applications_text_ck.name: applications_text_ck
applications_text_ck.value:
(facts_snapshot_hash IS NULL OR facts_snapshot_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        AND (resume_file_key IS NULL OR char_length(resume_file_key) <= 200)
        AND (failure_reason IS NULL OR char_length(failure_reason) <= 500)
        AND (lease_session_id IS NULL OR char_length(lease_session_id) <= 100)

applications_file_key_ck.name: applications_file_key_ck
applications_file_key_ck.value: resume_file_key IS NULL OR starts_with(resume_file_key, 'snapshots/' || user_id || '/')

credit_ledger_sign_ck.name: credit_ledger_sign_ck
credit_ledger_sign_ck.value:
(reason IN ('plan_grant','free_grant','refund_failed_submit') AND delta > 0) OR (reason = 'submission' AND delta = -1)
        OR (reason = 'expiry' AND delta < 0) OR (reason = 'admin_adjustment' AND delta <> 0 AND note IS NOT NULL)

credit_ledger_shape_ck.name: credit_ledger_shape_ck
credit_ledger_shape_ck.value:
(reason IN ('plan_grant','expiry') AND stripe_invoice_id IS NOT NULL AND application_id IS NULL)
        OR (reason = 'free_grant' AND stripe_invoice_id IS NULL AND application_id IS NULL)
        OR (reason IN ('submission','refund_failed_submit') AND stripe_invoice_id IS NULL)
        OR (reason = 'admin_adjustment' AND stripe_invoice_id IS NULL)

submission_attempts_code_ck.name: submission_attempts_code_ck
submission_attempts_code_ck.value:
failure_code IS NULL OR failure_code IN ('challenge','posting_closed','required_missing','applier_error','unconfirmed','timeout',
        'no_report','plan_lapsed','cloud_unavailable_for_ats','extension_reported','render_failed')

submission_attempts_approved_by_ck.name: submission_attempts_approved_by_ck
submission_attempts_approved_by_ck.value: approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by IN ('user','autopilot')

submission_attempts_result_ck.name: submission_attempts_result_ck
submission_attempts_result_ck.value:
(state = 'open' AND failure_code IS NULL)
        OR (state = 'submitted' AND (failure_code IS NULL OR late_confirmation))
        OR (state = 'failed' AND failure_code IS NOT NULL)
        OR (state = 'needs_check' AND failure_code IN ('unconfirmed','timeout','no_report'))

submission_attempts_settled_ck.name: submission_attempts_settled_ck
submission_attempts_settled_ck.value:
(settled_at IS NULL OR state <> 'open')
        AND NOT (state = 'failed' AND settled_at IS NOT NULL AND failure_code IN ('unconfirmed','timeout','no_report'))

submission_attempts_channel_ck.name: submission_attempts_channel_ck
submission_attempts_channel_ck.value:
(channel = 'extension' OR session_id IS NULL)
        AND (channel = 'cloud' OR (worker_identity IS NULL AND browser_launched_at IS NULL AND submit_seen_at IS NULL AND heartbeat_at IS NULL))

submission_attempts_evidence_ck.name: submission_attempts_evidence_ck
submission_attempts_evidence_ck.value:
evidence IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(evidence) = 'object' AND pg_column_size(evidence) <= 4096
        AND NOT (evidence ?| ARRAY['filledFields','values','answers','receipt']))

submission_attempts_text_ck.name: submission_attempts_text_ck
submission_attempts_text_ck.value: (session_id IS NULL OR char_length(session_id) <= 100) AND (worker_identity IS NULL OR char_length(worker_identity) <= 100)

generated.as: CASE WHEN actor = 'user' THEN 'user' ELSE 'system' END

application_events_app_ck.name: application_events_app_ck
application_events_app_ck.value: application_id IS NOT NULL OR kind IN ('saved','stage_changed','interview_added','note_added')

application_events_payload_ck.name: application_events_payload_ck
application_events_payload_ck.value:
jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object' AND pg_column_size(payload) <= 1024
        AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(payload, '$.* ? (@.type() == "object" || @.type() == "array")')
        AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(payload, '$.* ? (@ like_regex "^.{201}")')

tracker_items_closed_ck.name: tracker_items_closed_ck
tracker_items_closed_ck.value:
(stage = 'closed') = (closed_reason IS NOT NULL)
        AND (closed_reason IS NULL OR closed_reason IN ('rejected','withdrawn','not_pursuing','posting_closed'))

tracker_items_text_ck.name: tracker_items_text_ck
tracker_items_text_ck.value:
(title IS NULL OR char_length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 500) AND (company IS NULL OR char_length(company) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)
        AND (location IS NULL OR char_length(location) <= 500) AND (url IS NULL OR (char_length(url) <= 2000 AND url ~* '^https?://'))
        AND (notes IS NULL OR char_length(notes) <= 20000) AND (salary_text IS NULL OR char_length(salary_text) <= 200)
        AND char_length(position) BETWEEN 1 AND 64

tracker_items_snapshot_ck.name: tracker_items_snapshot_ck
tracker_items_snapshot_ck.value: job_snapshot IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(job_snapshot) = 'object' AND octet_length(job_snapshot::text) <= 65536)
